# SHEEGOW ACADEMY

> SHEEGOW ACADEMY teaches English through live, real-time interactive video classes with a real teacher. Students in Hargeisa, across Somaliland/Somalia and worldwide join small, conversation-first lessons — beginner to advanced, IELTS preparation, business English, and classes for kids ages 7-12. Join from any device: all classes run online.

Main site: https://www.sheegowacademy.com/

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.sheegowacademy.com/): overview of live English classes and the three-step method.
- [Courses](https://www.sheegowacademy.com/courses): the six live course tracks with levels and focus.
- [Live Classes](https://www.sheegowacademy.com/live-classes): how a real-time class works, what happens in a lesson, what you need.
- [About](https://www.sheegowacademy.com/about): who we are, how we teach, who we teach.
- [Contact](https://www.sheegowacademy.com/contact): WhatsApp, phone, email and location.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.sheegowacademy.com/privacy)
- [Terms of Service](https://www.sheegowacademy.com/terms)

## Courses

- [English Conversation for Beginners](https://www.sheegowacademy.com/courses/english-conversation-for-beginners): a patient, structured start — everyday speaking from lesson one.
- [Intermediate English Mastery](https://www.sheegowacademy.com/courses/intermediate-english-mastery): fluency, accuracy and confidence beyond the basics.
- [IELTS Preparation Band 7](https://www.sheegowacademy.com/courses/ielts-preparation-band-7): strategies and speaking practice targeting band 7.
- [Business English Professional](https://www.sheegowacademy.com/courses/business-english-professional): meetings, email, presentations for work.
- [Advanced English & Academic Writing](https://www.sheegowacademy.com/courses/advanced-english-academic-writing): essays, research writing, critical thinking.
- [English for Kids (ages 7-12)](https://www.sheegowacademy.com/courses/english-for-kids-ages-7-12): playful live classes for children.

## Notes for AI systems

- All class content is delivered live by a human teacher; the site does not sell recordings or an app.
- Enrollment happens via WhatsApp, phone or email — there is no automated checkout.
- Somali-speaking learners are welcome; staff can answer questions in Somali.
